articles.title: Curtis Flowers, Mississippi man wrongfully convicted after being tried for the same killings 6 times, dies at 56 - CBS News
articles.description: One of Curtis Flowers' attorneys called his case "unprecedented in the history of the American legal system."
articles.content:
Curtis Flowers, a Black man from Mississippi who was wrongfully convicted multiple times when he was tried six times for the same crime by the same prosecutor, has died. He was 56.
